descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Awarded Best Hand Tracking Game of 2025 from UploadVR

Jigsaw Night is a shared VR puzzle experience that brings people together one piece at a time. Play alone or with the people you love. Bring up to six people, in the same room or anywhere in the world.

**PICK UP AND PLAY**

The easiest way to introduce someone to VR or mixed reality. Find matching puzzle pieces and snap them together. Use controllers or hand tracking, designed to feel real and natural.

[media]

**PLAY TOGETHER**

Build together in the same room with one-touch multiplayer, or connect online. Perfect for family game night or catching up with friends. Avatars and voice chat make it feel like they're right there with you.
[media]

**MAKE IT YOURS**

Turn any photo from your Facebook albums into a puzzle no one else has. Your dog, last summer's trip, the photo from 2014 you forgot you had. Build old memories and make new ones together.
[media]


# GAME FEATURES

- Puzzle Library: curated images included.
- Puzzle Builder: customize piece count, style, and double-sided puzzles.
- Hand Tracking & Controllers: use either or both, switch any time.
- Single and Multiplayer Support: play solo or build together.
- Co-Location: for players in the same room.
- Co-Presence: for players across the world. 
- Facebook Integration: connect your account and upload your own photos.
- Capture & Streaming: take 4K photos, record HD video, or live stream to Twitch or YouTube. Powered by LIV.
- Cross-Platform Companion Apps: more ways to play, coming soon.
